definitions.score: architecture score on a dataset = mean over images (V6 exclusions) of its per-image Dice or NSD
definitions.agreement: Spearman (Pearson on average ranks, ties averaged) over the architectures present in both vectors
definitions.seed_averaged: mean over the architecture's available seeds (as perimage_v7 load7)
definitions.floor_rule: M19 group mean Dice < 0.1 (V6 floor rule)

seed0_old10_vs_v6_M_columns.what: dataset means of the 10 old architectures, seed 0 (load_seed) vs V6 '<arch>_in' columns, 12 datasets x 2 metrics; differences are float summation order only

variance_split_definitions.between_sd_avg18: SD (ddof 1) of the 18 seed-averaged architecture means
variance_split_definitions.between_sd_bal16: SD (ddof 1) of the 16 balanced architectures' 3-seed means
variance_split_definitions.within_sd_bal16: sqrt(MSW): pooled SD across seeds within architecture, 16 architectures x 3 seeds, df 32
variance_split_definitions.icc1_single_seed: (MSB - MSW) / (MSB + 2 MSW): share of the variance of one-seed architecture means that is between architectures
variance_split_definitions.icc_k3_seed_mean: (MSB - MSW) / MSB: same for the mean of 3 seeds (reliability of a seed-averaged architecture mean)
variance_split_definitions.note: ICC can be negative when between-architecture differences are smaller than seed noise

seed_noise_corrected_ratio.what: matched cross-dataset mean / same-dataset cross-seed mean (ratio of means; the V6 disattenuation formula with seed-to-seed agreement as the reliability)
matched cross-dataset mean / same-dataset cross-seed mean (ratio of means; the V6 disattenuation formula with seed-to-seed agreement as the reliability)
